svg.title: RoadAnomaly — C4 component view of the inference path
svg.desc: C4 component diagram: the API, the technical demo, the product and the video script call the inference service, which checks uploads, caches models and adds overlays and statistics; notebook 5 and the landing export use the Predictor directly. The service asks the explanation module for Grad-CAM++ and exact SHAP, both of which score through the Predictor; the Predictor reads a model folder and hands its score map to post-processing, which returns the mask.
